text:
The central conflict in the text revolves around the clash between economic greed and cultural preservation. Jacob, a prospector, discovers gold on land that is sacred to a local indigenous tribe. This discovery creates a direct opposition between Jacob’s potential for personal gain and the tribe's chief’s determination to protect their heritage. The situation escalates when outsiders become aware of the gold, forcing Jacob to face a moral dilemma regarding his loyalties.

The longest river in the world is the Nile River.
